records.title: The Provision of ShareFile Licences (2026)
records.description: HSE were looking for a supplier for Progress ShareFile, a secure file transfer solution for sending large data files to other organisations; which cannot be sent by email. The supplier was chosen via TePAs2 Lot 3 (RM6098).

records.title: Purchase of 5 Servers
records.description:
For the Purchase and Supply of five (5) Servers.

Delivery date is expected to be as soon as possible, and no later
than four months after the order is placed.

Further Competition Under Government Commercial Agency framework; Ref: RM6098 - Technology Products and Associated Services 2 (TePAS2) Lot 2 - Hardware.

records.title: Software License Reseller Agreement
records.description:
This is a Contract Award Notice.

The Care Quality Commission (CQC) require the services of a Software License Reseller.

This procurement was undertaken through the GCA Technology Products & Associated Service 2 Framework Agreement (RM6098), Lot 3 Software, following the Direct Award process.

The Contract is awarded for a total period of 24 months.

Total Awarded Value is maximum of all charges including any optional contract extensions.             

Contract Reference: CQC TDI 039
